messages.subject: modelling recurrents events taking into account the order of the events!
parts:
I used the SPDE models with INLA almost 2 years ago but I still don't understand why we have to put "0 + a0" in the formula.

                                                  formula <- inla.surv(times, Status) ~ 0 + a0 + Treatment + Age + Sex +  f(spatial, model=CoxSPDE)

Please, could someone to explain us under which condition "0+ a0" should be added to the formula and exactly how important it would be? Why can't we write like that...
                                     
                                                formula <- inla.surv(times, Status) ~   Treatment + Age + Sex +  f(spatial, model=CoxSPDE)



In addition, I would like to model recurrents events taking into account the order of the events. Could adding "f(Order, model="iid") in to model formula solve the problem? 
Since the risk decreases according to the order of events, we can put "f(Order, model="ar1) ?

formula <- inla.surv(times, Status, subject) ~ Treatment + Age + Sex +  f(spatial, model=CoxSPDE) + f(Order, model="ar1")


Thank you in advance for your support, it would be a great pleasure to have the solution to my problem on this forum....

Kindly!
Abdoulaye
